reviews.text: Great place for dogs, from training to daycare

Excellent place! I take my dogs there for baths and haircuts, and they come out looking beautiful and smelling great for days. They've also had their dogs cared for during the day and even overnight, and everything has been great! 👍🏽 I highly recommend them. …
Excellent service 👌🏼 Highly recommended and very reliable for dog care 💖🙏🏼 …
They really pamper my dog, highly recommended!
They are excellent at looking after and caring for our furry friends, and they also excel in the activities they do.

Irresponsible. Don't take your dogs there; they don't care about their well-being. My dog ​​was injured while with them, and they covered it up; they didn't notify me. They didn't take responsibility.
They take no responsibility and don't seem to care if one of the animals they care for gets hurt. Their response to incidents is terrible (nonexistent).
Great place to leave your pet

They take great care of pets, and they have packages! In our experience, the whole team has always been friendly, and most importantly, our dog comes back happy from daycare. We've also left her at their boarding facility and had her bathed. They follow all the instructions we give for bathing, and we feel very comfortable leaving our fur baby with them. We've settled in very well! I definitely recommend them <3

We love it!! Moka goes to the pool once or twice a month. Excellent service and treatment. 100% recommended!!

2023 Update: They used to be very friendly and attentive. On one occasion, they didn't give me the service because they wrote down the appointment incorrectly. It was confirmed via WhatsApp at 2 pm, and when I arrived, they told me it was at 12 pm... On another occasion, the boiler broke down, but they didn't notify me, so I arrived and they turned me away. I get the impression that they were successful and haven't made any effort to improve. I'm deducting stars.

It's a nice, large place.
The only thing I don't like is that they don't send photos.
The grounds are spacious, and nothing has ever happened to my dog ​​there.
